questions.question:

Detailed list of goods dispatched with quantity and price to the purchaser.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is Option 4. i.e. **"invoice"**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Invoice**: A list of goods sent or services provided, with a statement of the sum due for these; a bill. (चालान: भेजी गई वस्तुओं की सूची या प्रदान की गई सेवाओं के साथ, इनके लिए देय राशि का एक वक्तव्य; एक बिल।)

 
 
• **Example**: The contractor issued an invoice for the completed work to the homeowner.
 
 
 
• Invoice interprets the given group of words "Detailed list of goods dispatched with quantity and price to the purchaser".

Therefore, the correct answer is "invoice".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• Sales: The exchange of a commodity for money. (बिक्री: किसी वस्तु का पैसे के लिए आदान-प्रदान;)
 
• Receipt: A written acknowledgment that something of value has been transferred from one party to another. (रसीद: एक लिखित स्वीकृति कि मूल्य की कोई चीज़ एक पार्टी से दूसरे को स्थानांतरित की गई है।)

questions.question:
**Directions: Select the most appropriate one-word substitution for the given words.**

A disease that is found in a particular place and is difficult to get rid of.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is 'Endemic'.

***__Key Points__**

• 'Chronic' is **(of an illness) persisting for a long time or constantly recurring**.

 
 
• Example: *If left untreated the condition may become **chronic***.
 
 
 
• 'Pandemic' is **(of a disease) prevalent over a whole country or the world**.
 
 
• Example: *All countries should immediately activate their **pandemic** preparedness plans*.
 
 
 
• 'Infection' is **the process of infecting or the state of being infected**.
 
 
• Example: *She has got an ear **infection***.
 
 
 
• 'Endemic' is **(of a disease or condition) regularly found among particular people or in a certain area**.
 
 
• Example: *Chest disease is **endemic** among miners in this area*.

 
 
 
 
 

Hence, the correct answer is option 4.*
